title: Keyless
description: A modern, high-performance authentication system for Minecraft featuring chat-intercept login and lightweight architecture.
body:
# 🌪️ KEYLESS ### *Modern Authentication. Reimagined.* > **Next-generation authentication for modern Minecraft servers.** > No legacy bloat. No overhead. Just pure, secure, lightning-fast login. ---
## ⚔️ Why Keyless? Most authentication plugins were built years ago and have never caught up. They're heavy, bloated, and rely on outdated paradigms. **Keyless is different.** Architected from scratch for modern servers, Keyless delivers a seamless, secure, and server-friendly authentication experience — without compromising on performance or simplicity. --- ## 🌟 Core Features ### 🛡️ Chat-Intercept Login No commands. No friction. Players simply type their password directly into chat for a natural, modern login flow. Clean, fast, and intuitive. ### 🌌 Native Void World Generation Keyless automatically generates an isolated void world for the login process — **no extra plugins or world generators required.** Fully self-contained. ### 🔐 BCrypt Encryption Industry-standard password hashing keeps your players' credentials safe. No shortcuts, no compromises. ### 🎨 Professional Admin GUI A sleek, symmetrical, and fully localized management panel accessible via `/kl menu`. Manage everything without touching a single config file. ### 🚀 Flexible Login Modes Choose the mode that fits your network's architecture: | Mode | Description | |------|-------------| | `WORLD` | Teleport players to a dedicated login world | | `SERVER` | Route players through a proxy login server | | `DISABLED` | Turn off login isolation entirely | ### 💎 Premium Auto-Login Full support for official **Mojang/Microsoft** accounts. Verified players skip authentication entirely — instant, seamless access. --- ## 🛠️ Technical Specifications | Property | Detail | |----------|--------| | **Version Support** | Minecraft 1.8 → 1.21+ | | **Platforms** | Paper, Spigot, Purpur | | **Performance** | Hand-optimized • 0ms delay target • Low memory footprint | | **Encryption** | BCrypt (industry-standard) | | **Dependencies** | None — fully self-contained | --- ## ⚡ Quick Start 1. Download the latest `.jar` from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/keyless) or [Releases](../../releases) 2. Place the file into your server's `/plugins` folder 3. Restart your server 4. Configure via `/kl menu` or edit `config.yml` That's it. No bloat, no setup nightmares. --- ## 📋 Commands & Permissions | Command | Description | Permission | |---------|-------------|------------| | `/kl menu` | Open the admin management GUI | `keyless.admin` | | `/kl reload` | Reload the configuration | `keyless.admin` | --- ## 🏗️ Built By
Developed with ❤️ by **Levxys** & **[SkyWind Alliance](https://github.com/SkyWindAlliance)** *"Rüzgar Ruhu — The spirit that balances, never breaks."* ---
